fields.description: 16-byte ASCII save identifier 'AGBNBC VER 0000' with NUL terminator at the start of the EEPROM record (logical domain).
fields.evidence: Logical (rev8) bytes 0x00-0x0F of baseline.sav read 'AGBNBC VER 0000 0x00'; record is stored/loaded in 8-byte blocks by FUN_08103dd4 (EEPROM block read from 0xd000000) / FUN_08103e98 and FUN_08103e84 (block write) with read-compare verify in FUN_08103ff8.
fields.name: save_identifier

fields.description: First data byte of the save record (EEPROM block 2, low byte). Candidate record tag/status byte; no Schema v2 checksum algorithm verifies against it, so it is kept as data.
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x10 holds 0xD9 in baseline.sav; transferred as part of EEPROM block 2 by FUN_08103dd4 (read) / FUN_08103e98 (write) via FUN_08103d54 DMA to 0xd000000; verify path FUN_08103ff8 and wrappers FUN_08104074/FUN_08104078/FUN_08104080.
fields.name: record_tag

fields.description: Three erased-state (0xFF) bytes following the record tag; unwritten EEPROM area inside block 2.
fields.evidence: Logical offsets 0x11-0x13 read 0xFF (erased EEPROM value) in baseline.sav; covered by the same 8-byte block I/O as record_tag in FUN_08103dd4 / FUN_08103e98 (0xd000000).
fields.name: erased_gap

fields.description: Small progress scalar, value 1 in the live save; plausibly a stage/world or file-progress index.
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x14 holds 0x01 in baseline.sav; saved in EEPROM block 2 via the FUN_08103e98 block-write path (0xd000000) and read back by FUN_08103dd4; exact gameplay binding unconfirmed (driver dispatch is indirect through the 0x0810408c table).
fields.name: stage_progress

fields.description: Small progress scalar, value 5 in the live save; plausibly a chapter/level or completion counter.
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x15 holds 0x05 in baseline.sav; saved in EEPROM block 2 via the FUN_08103e98 block-write path (0xd000000) and read back by FUN_08103dd4.
fields.name: chapter_progress

fields.description: Flag-like scalar, value 0x0A (bits 1 and 3) in the live save; plausibly an unlock/feature flag set.
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x18 holds 0x0A in baseline.sav; first byte of EEPROM block 3, written by FUN_08103e98 and read by FUN_08103dd4 (0xd000000) with verify in FUN_08103ff8.
fields.name: unlock_flags

fields.description: Small config/progress scalar, value 2 in the live save; plausibly an option setting or sub-stage index.
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x1A holds 0x02 in baseline.sav; EEPROM block 3 byte handled by the FUN_08103e98 write / FUN_08103dd4 read pair (0xd000000).
fields.name: option_setting

fields.description: Small counter scalar, value 1 in the live save.
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x20 holds 0x01 in baseline.sav; first byte of EEPROM block 4, written by FUN_08103e98 and read by FUN_08103dd4 (0xd000000).
fields.name: counter_a

fields.description: Small counter scalar, value 1 in the live save.
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x21 holds 0x01 in baseline.sav; EEPROM block 4 byte handled by the FUN_08103e98 write / FUN_08103dd4 read pair (0xd000000).
fields.name: counter_b

fields.description: Small counter scalar, value 2 in the live save.
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x22 holds 0x02 in baseline.sav; EEPROM block 4 byte handled by the FUN_08103e98 write / FUN_08103dd4 read pair (0xd000000), verified by FUN_08103ff8.
fields.name: counter_c

fields.description: Lone non-blank byte deep in the record (value 0x10); role unconfirmed (marker, length, or version tag). Genuinely written data, not padding: it is the only set byte in EEPROM blocks 5-51.
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x15B holds 0x10 in baseline.sav (EEPROM block 43); sparse single-byte writes go through the same FUN_08103e98 block-write / FUN_08103dd4 block-read routines (0xd000000).
fields.name: far_marker

fields.description: Second copy of the 16-byte ASCII identifier at logical 0x1A4 (EEPROM blocks 52-54). Its data tail is erased (0xFF), so it is NOT a redundant mirror of the primary record and is not in copy_groups.
fields.evidence: Logical bytes 0x1A4-0x1B3 of baseline.sav read 'AGBNBC VER 0000 0x00' (same bytes as save_identifier); readable through the FUN_08103dd4 block-read path (0xd000000).
fields.name: backup_identifier

Backup copy of the save identifier at logical 0x1A4
